_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Equipment Technical Manual (Sanitized)
summary: Specifies content requirements for a sanitized Equipment Technical Manual providing detailed operations and maintenance information for the operator and maintenance technician.
use_relationship:
The Equipment Technical Manual contains detailed operations and maintenance information primarily intended for the operator and the maintenance technician.

a. This Data Item Description (DID) calls for the contractor to provide an Equipment Technical Manual for fully configured systems as specified in the agreement, contract or order when delivered and installed by the installation team. The Equipment Technical Manual content shall include detailed operation and maintenance information covering: overall description of the equipment, installation instructions, descriptions of operating controls and indicators, operating instructions, general and detailed principles of operation, preventative and corrective maintenance procedures, replaceable parts lists with supporting engineering drawings/diagrams/figures.

b. For purposes of this DID, "Sanitized" is defined as the removal of any ties to the government or agency from the submitted Equipment Technical Manual.

c. The Equipment Technical Manual can be used alone or in conjunction with the other manuals developed by a contractor using DI-TMSS-81676B, Subsystem Technical Manual, or DI-TMSS-81677B, System Technical Manual.

d. Illustrations and engineering drawings shall be in accordance with DI-TMSS-81678A, Engineering Documentation Product Drawings, Sanitized or DI-TMSS-81679A, Engineering Documentation Products Drawings, Modified and Sanitized, as stated in the contract.

e. This DID supersedes DI-TMSS-81675.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.
